newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Coffee poised to challenge nearby support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Coffee poised to challenge nearby support.

text.p: MAY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Robusta coffee futures are poised to move lower and challenge trendline support at $1,530 basis May, as the key contract upside momentum starts to flag, technical analysts said on Wednesday.

"It's ranging downwards...and I would have said there's fair chance it's going to break to the downside," said Susan Rigg, a technical analyst at Chart Analysis. "It really needs to move above $1,680."
The spot position has recently been trapped in a series of relatively tight ranges, finding it difficult to break back and hold above $1,600.
May's crucial upside target was still at last month's double-top formation, two peaks at $1,820 and $1,825, but the position would need more momentum first, Rigg said.
"It's got a downward trend but it's not very well defined ever since there was that ($1,825) peak. I would have said it's more likely to challenge lateral support."

Traders called the London market to open up to $60 lower than Tuesday's close based on a theoretical calculation after New York's weaker performance but said an open of between $30 and $40 lower was more likely.
On the downside, May is likely to target a series of reaction lows placed along a trendline dating from support at a $1,421 runaway gap in mid-January.
Traders said the GCA stock data released in New York, when stocks rose by 111,000 bags, was below general expectations and was mildly bullish for the market.
In other news, Brazilian stevedores are to go on national strike in sympathy with their Santos colleagues at midnight Thursday (0300 GMT Friday) for 48 hours.

Santos stevedores have started an indefinite strike in protest against steel firm Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) using its own workers to load and unload vessels at its private terminal at the port.
